found.finding: A Flipkart payout line with no NEFT key over a row summed from keyed payouts replaced the sum.
found.fix: ledger.plan: a keyless line over a keyed row changes no money and is said (Disagreement).
found.proved_by: ledger_checks PR1c 1 (three checks: mixed lines in both orders)
found.why: Brings the A10 fault back for good if left.

found.finding: Clock: a late catch-up run recorded on the next day made the next evening's on-time tick 'finished today' and the late tick after it 'yesterday had a run'.
found.fix: clock._evening_day: a run before 06:00 belongs to the evening before, for every floor, and is compared by when it STARTED.
found.proved_by: clock_checks PR1c (two-day, floor 0/2, run finishing after 06:00)
found.why: An evening would never be fetched.

found.finding: A word typed in the notes (pay:later) was taken for a payout key.
found.fix: Keys are now fkpay:<id> with an id of 8+ characters containing a digit (payments.is_payout_key); everything else is no key.

found.finding: The same payout restated with a different figure was dropped silently.
found.fix: Said as a Disagreement when the row holds exactly that one payout (compared with the row as the reading found it).
found.why: A restated payout is a thing the seller must know.

found.finding: Thousands of 'kept old figure' lines on the repair night.
found.fix: One count line with total; named only if the sale is nought or less or a later payout ended the night.

found.finding: Several payouts for one order in one file: the second never added.
found.fix: payments._PayoutGroups: one line per payout; ledger keeps lines of different payouts apart.
found.proved_by: payments_checks PR1c 6; ledger_checks PR1c 6 (four); the 46 real files
found.why: The real files have 325 such lines.

found.finding: Before-history money total used the settlement only; the cut uses the file date.
found.fix: Total includes charge-only lines (sign: charges negated). The 45-day margin on the file day is ACCEPTED for history (Control's choice).

found.finding: paymentsOn went backwards when an older payout was added.
found.fix: Kept at the newest payments day.
found.why: The age check and the ERP read it.

found.finding: dry_run recorded a combined figure under each key of a merged line.
found.fix: Reads keys with the ledger's own test; lists orders paid in several payouts in one file.

found.finding: (introduced by the finding-6 fix) a keyless line of an order that also had a keyed line in the same file was set first and then replaced by the keyed one.
found.fix: Keyless lines stay apart and go LAST, where the ledger says them instead of adding them.

found.finding: A seller note like pay:15Nov2026 passed the key shape.
found.fix: Prefix changed to fkpay: (keys were never released).

found.finding: Wrong sign on charge-only money in the before-history total.
found.proved_by: ledger_sheet_checks PR1c 7 (input flipped to the readers' sign)
found.why: Total off by twice each charge.

found.finding: Clock: floors under 6 had late ticks too.
found.fix: Evening-day is taken for every floor.

found.finding: Clock: a late run that finished after 06:00 was filed under the next evening.
A rebate was lost when the order already had two payouts on its row.
found.fix: A rebate with a valid NEFT id of its own is its own line under its own key; with none it rides on the first payout that states the order.

found.finding: A blank-NEFT line folded into a payout it may not belong to was counted twice when it came back.
found.fix: Not folded any more; kept apart, last, said.

found.finding: A restated payout was not said when a new payout sorted before it in the same file.
found.fix: Row's payouts and figure are taken at the start of each reading.

found.finding: A late tick (00:30) fetches the day that ended 30 minutes earlier; the on-time tick would have fetched the day before. A short early file would be treated as fetched.
found.why: Needs the run-day recording in nightly.py changed (today = moment.date()), not a payments/ledger fix; the reviewer's impact on Amazon/Flipkart data is a guess, not checked. REGISTERED as the next AutoSync round's row and a release condition to check: nothing in the 46 files or the clock says it has happened.

found.finding: A restated payout on a row holding two or more payouts cannot be compared (no per-key figure is stored); the very first run of an install refuses a late small-hours tick; a tick more than 12 hours late is refused.
found.why: Named limits: per-key figures would change the row format; the other two cost one evening once or need a tick more than 12 hours late (never seen: 3.5 to 7 hours in 14 days of run lists).

found.finding: A legacy row (no keys) takes the first keyed payout by REPLACING its figure, said as 'restated'; wrong if that figure came from a different payout whose file is gone.
found.why: It is the repair mechanism for the A10 fault; the replacement is said line by line. The 46 real files rebuild correctly in every order.
